ram.note: total_bytes and available_bytes are for this process: the host value, or the cgroup (container) limit if it is lower. In a cgroup, available_bytes is the smaller of the host value and the room: the limit minus the working set (cgroup_used_bytes = cgroup_current_bytes minus the inactive file pages). The kernel takes the inactive page cache back when a process needs memory, so it is not counted as used.
